summary: GreenPower Motor filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report on Form 8-K) announcing a proposed 1-for-5 share consolidation intended to regain compliance with Nasdaq's $1 minimum bid price requirement. The consolidation would reduce outstanding shares from 10,503,546 to approximately 2,100,709, with proportional adjustment to options, warrants, and convertible debentures. Nasdaq approval is required; the effective date and new CUSIP/name/symbol are not yet announced. No fractional shares will be issued; fractions round up. Watch for Nasdaq approval, the effective date, and any reverse-split-related volatility or trading adjustment, plus continued listing maintenance.
